A grounded place to begin

What happened can shake your sense of safety. Healing can rebuild it.

Fraud and abuse can affect far more than finances. They can change how you trust, sleep, make decisions, and relate to the people around you.

Here, emotional recovery and practical next steps belong in the same conversation. You will find clear information, compassionate perspective, and support that respects your autonomy.

A trauma-informed approach

There is no single right way to recover.

1

Regain steadiness

Simple grounding tools can help when fear, anger, or self-doubt feels overwhelming.

2

Make sense of the impact

Name what changed without reducing your experience to a diagnosis or a financial loss.

3

Choose what comes next

Build a realistic path forward based on your needs, values, and pace.

Being deceived does not make you foolish. It means someone misused your trust.
